messages:
maya_csm: Quick sync for NimbusCo dedicated capacity commissioning. Customer requested committed quota + burst and wants a phased rollout with a business-review call after the evening stress test. High level: agree quota units, autoscale packing, and two run windows (preflight + full stress). Who can own the quota mapping?
jorge_se: I can take quota mapping. They asked for 900k tokens/day guaranteed, burst to 1.8M for up to 4 hours. Recommend committing 925k tokens/day on reserved pool and enabling a burst_bucket backed by the burst_pool with token_bucket: rate=1000rps, capacity=50k tokens. Will export YAML.
tess_sre: Autoscale recs: prefer GPU packing to reduce idle GPUs. Use min_replicas=1, max_replicas=12, target_gpu_util=70%, pack_policy=balanced. Add a "cold_warm" hook: if instance spin-up latency > 90s, extend routing grace by 6 minutes.
ravi_ops: Run windows: preflight (15% traffic) Fri 14:00-14:30 PDT, full evening stress Sat 20:00-22:00 PDT. I'll create k6 + vegeta hybrids for realistic distribution. Quick snippet for vegeta: 
```bash
echo 'GET https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate' | vegeta attack -rate=1200 -duration=20m | vegeta report
```
maya_csm: They also flagged renewal risk if onboarding misses key SLA targets (they're on a Q4 renewal). Let's make sure we capture perf numbers and a short risk mitigation note for the account exec.
sasha_account: Thanks for flagging. I'll add a 1-paragraph risk note after tests: include p90/p99, error %, and a remediation timeline.
jorge_se: Fallback plan: serve a smaller quantized variant on q4-cpu-pool if the reserved GPU pool drops below 30% capacity. We'll prepare a variant named nimbus-lite-q8 and verify logits match threshold.
tess_sre: Alert thresholds proposal: p50>350ms OR p90>900ms OR p99>1800ms OR api_error_rate>0.5% sustained for 10m -> trigger incident, auto-shift to fallback at 50% traffic and open pager. Also create a non-pager warning at 5m for SRE eyes only.
ravi_ops: Rollout phases we'll run: canary 5% (10m), ramp 25% (20m), ramp 60% (30m), full 100% (until window end). Preflight will be 15% for 30m as smoke.
deploybot: deploy-bot: job created "nimbus-commissioning-run" preflight Fri-2026-03-19T21:00:00Z, stress Sat-2026-03-20T03:00:00Z. CI status: infra-check=pass, model-compat=pass.
maya_csm: Data residency: Nimbus insisted on logs and audit traces kept in eu-west-1. Tess, can you confirm log-ship + KMS policy?
tess_sre: Will set log-ship to eu-west-1 bucket with kms-key=nimbus-eu-kms, retention=180d. Metrics will be tagged customer:nimbusco to prevent mixing.
jorge_se: I'll upload shard/packing YAML and the quantized fallback build to the docs folder by EOD tomorrow.
ravi_ops: Load script notes: include randomized prompt lengths (mean 60 tokens, stdev 20) and a 15% retry jitter. Capture per-request token-count to compute billing delta.
maya_csm: Who owns post-test artifacts (report + recordings + incident notes)? Need that for the renewal package.
sasha_account: I'll collect and stitch the report and finish the renewal risk blurb.
tess_sre: I'll own alerts + runbook entries and link them in the ticket.
ravi_ops: I'll drop the k6/vegeta scripts in the repo and share run output to the channel.
maya_csm: Agreed. Final callouts: confirm timezone conversions in calendar invite (PDT vs CET), confirm backup routing to cpu-pool, and customer contact on-call for the evening window. Reconvene Thu EOD if any blockers.
jorge_se: On it.
tess_sre: Copy.
ravi_ops: Scheduling and scripts in progress.
maya_csm: Thanks team :white_check_mark:
